description: This file defines a wizard interface for employee sign-in and sign-out management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including XML form definitions, logic for sign-in/out actions, and state transitions.

classes.name: wiz_si_so
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing sign-in/sign-out process states

methods.name: _get_empid
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID, name, and state based on current user

methods.name: _sign_in
methods.description: Handles employee sign-in logic, including validation and recording

methods.name: _sign_out
methods.description: Handles employee sign-out logic, including validation and recording

methods.name: _si_check
methods.description: Determines whether the employee should sign in or out based on last attendance action

methods.name: _so_check
methods.description: Checks if the employee's last attendance was a sign-in or sign-out to decide next step
